A1.description:
PLEASE READ THE SETUP GUIDE THERE ARE IMPORTANT THINGS THERE

    Features:
    -All Blocks in Peach's Castle (Destroyed) and Sunbeam Plains are checks
    -All Field moves are progression items
    -All consumable items are filler
    -No logic has been implemented yet, and there is no goal trigger

     Known Quirks/Issues:
    -When a move is received, you will have to open the menu and close it for the move to appear
    -Blocks that can be hit more than once are only intended to be hit once, and you will end up with extra items if they are hit more than 
     once
    -The debug code was left in intentionally

Please report bugs on the issues page
A1.title: Alpha Release 1

A2.description:
All blocks and beanspots have been added as locations
-Only the locations in Sunbeam Plains and Doop Doop Dunes are named correctly, all other locations are placeholder names
A2.title: Alpha Release 2
